_about: C-34, C-51: TV remotes by brand, for FLARE when the remote is lost -- each set is a whole remote, POWER, VOLUME UP and VOLUME DOWN, so once its POWER works the other two are known. Written here from each protocol's published command table, not copied from a code database: Sony SIRC is device 1 (TV) with commands 21 (power), 18 (volume up) and 19 (volume down), 12 bits with SIRC's repeats; Samsung's and Panasonic's are their own protocols'; LG, Vizio and Toshiba use NEC. A start: brands and sets are added as they are checked, and a larger list only once its licence lets it live in this public repo.
